hook: Your Apple Watch app works in the simulator. Then crashes.

beats.say: An indie developer's Apple Watch app ran fine in the simulator, but wouldn't even build for real watches.
The reason: older Apple Watch models use arm64 underscore 32, where Swift's Int is only thirty-two bits. A hash constant simply didn't fit.
Worse, twenty-seven spots turned milliseconds into an Int that would crash on launch. The lesson: always build for real hardware.
